description: This PHP source file defines the 'OAuthClientAPI' class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides API endpoints for managing OAuth clients, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting OAuth client records. It features OpenAPI annotations for API documentation, validation rules, and methods to interact with OAuth client data through DAOs and models. The class leverages traits and extends a generic 'Endpoint' class, following RESTful principles.

classes.name: OAuthClientAPI
classes.description: API controller class for managing OAuth clients in the OrangeHRM system. Implements CRUD operations, validation, and data serialization for OAuth client entities via REST endpoints.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all OAuth clients with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new OAuth client, generating client ID and secret if necessary.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove specified OAuth clients by IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific OAuth client by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing OAuth client, managing secret regeneration if confidentiality status changes.

methods.name: generateSecret
methods.description: Generates a secure random secret string for OAuth client confidential clients.

methods.name: setOAuthClient
methods.description: Populates OAuthClient entity fields based on request body parameters.
